Subject (in full) Meeting of local communists in Eastern District.

Made by D. K. Kuh Pao Hwa. Forwarded by [Signature].

Between 10 a.m. and 11.10 a.m. June 2, about 20
persons representing the following organizations held a secret
meeting in an unnumbered house at the corner of Hochien and
Meichow Roads, Yangtszepoo district:-
Committee to Support the Volunteer Armies in the North East.
Federation of Anti-Japanese Societies of Shanghai Masses.
Federation of Cotton Mill Workers' Unions.
Public Ricsha Coolies' Union.
Kiwa Cotton Mill Workers' Union.
Kung Dah Cotton Mill Workers' Union.
Union of Returned Students from Japan.
Anti-Japanese Society of Great China University.
Federation of Workers in Various Trades in Shanghai.
Federation of Unemployed Workers in Shanghai.
Postal Workers Union.
Newspaper Workers' Union.
Seamen's Union.
Wong Lau Nyi (王老二), representative of the Committee
to Support the Volunteer Armies in the North East, presided.
The following resolutions were discussed and passed:-
1) That a general meeting to commemorate the death of Koo
Tseng Hung (顾正红) (worker of the N.W.K. Cotton Mill who
was killed on May 14, 1925) be held in the Public Recreation
Ground, West Gate, at 10 a.m. June 5.
2) That the following organizations be appointed to make
preparations for commemorating the June 23rd Anniversary
(Anniversaries of the Shameen Incident in 1925 and of the
execution of Shang Tsoong Fah, a notorious communist, in
1931):-

6月2日上午10时至11时10分之间，约20名代表下列组织的人员在杨树浦区霍迁路（Hochien Road）与梅周路（Meichow Road）转角处一幢无门牌号的房屋内举行秘密会议：
支援东北义勇军委员会。
上海民众反日社团联合会。
棉厂工会联合会。
公共人力车夫工会。
启华纱厂工人工会。
公大纱厂工人工会。
留日归国学生联合会。
大夏大学反日会。
上海各业工人联合会。
上海失业工人联合会。
邮务员工会。
报界工会。
海员工会。
王老二，系支援东北义勇军委员会代表，担任主席。
讨论并通过以下决议：
1) 定于6月5日上午10时，在西门公共游乐场举行大会，纪念顾正红（N.W.K. 纱厂工人，于1925年5月14日被杀）之死。
2) 指定下列组织负责筹备纪念六月二十三日周年活动（1925年沙面事件周年及1931年著名共产党人尚忠发被执行死刑周年）：
